outbreaks.condition: existing administered settlement manpower; bounded contact disease exposure, no scripted political outcome

notes: Each settlement is a named local tax district within its authored province. Surveying every district costs 1% of the sum of provincial normal annual tax; partial surveys improve only the paid, known local district.

Capacity factors and tax share follow economy/balance.json; capital/port/market geography retain asymmetric revenue capacities. Actual collection transfers existing market liquidity to the controlling government's treasury.
Lawful civic institutions require current legal control and a serving local administrator; discussion begins in 1770 and progresses locally. Research never emancipates anyone or changes diplomacy.
Medical cloth is existing local stock used for dressings. A district without that commodity or access cannot activate a response. No supplies are granted.
Only the authored Hawaii contact exposure creates disease losses initially; future scenarios can author additional outbreaks. Medical response never reduces combat losses.
